result:
The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's replanning at step 31. At step 29 it had correctly asked for hikes from at least three different sources. The new plan then narrowed the work to the hikes from a single blog, Tales of a Mountain Mama, which it said explicitly ("only for the identified hikes from a single source"). That dropped the requirement of recommendations from at least three different people with kids. It also made the candidate list miss several of the correct hikes, such as Artist Point, Fountain Paint Pot and Storm Point. The final answer of Beaver Ponds, Grand Prismatic Overlook Trail and Wraith Falls Trail was therefore wrong.
